missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Мальчик' is in the nominative case as the subject. 'Этот' is the agreeing masculine demonstrative, and 'умный' is the predicate adjective praising him.

Strategic focus: Accusative direct object. 'Мальчик' is animate masculine, so its accusative 'мальчика' copies the genitive form. 'Вижу' takes the direct object, and 'маленького' agrees in animate accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Мальчика' is genitive after 'у' to show whose situation it is. The negative 'нет' then demands genitive 'велосипеда'. A clean double-genitive pattern.
Strategic focus: Dative recipient. 'Мальчику' is the dative indirect object, the one who receives. 'Дал' is the past-tense verb, and 'книгу' is the accusative thing given.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after an adjective. 'Мальчиком' is instrumental because 'доволен' governs that case. 'Этим' agrees in masculine instrumental, expressing satisfaction with him.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'О мальчике' uses the prepositional form after 'о' to mark the topic of conversation. 'Новом' agrees in masculine prepositional.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Мальчики' is the nominative plural acting as the subject. 'Играют' agrees in the plural, and 'во дворе' gives the location.
Strategic focus: Accusative animate plural. 'Мальчиков' is animate plural, so its accusative copies the genitive. 'Всех' and 'этих' agree in the same animate accusative form.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after a verb. 'Мальчиком' is instrumental because 'гордится' governs that case. 'Своим' agrees in masculine instrumental, expressing maternal pride.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after a number. 'Мальчиков' is genitive plural because 'трое' demands it. 'Маленьких' agrees in genitive plural, describing the neighbours' children.
